summary: Verified `auto_rejected` field exposure via sanitize_booking and Auto-rejected badge on Cek Status page. Backend correctly returns auto_rejected=true for layer-2 auto-rejected bookings and auto_rejected=false for manual rejections. Frontend renders the badge only for auto-rejected bookings, and rejection_reason text is preserved in both cases.
passed: POST /api/bookings/public creates bookings with future weekday dates
POST /api/bookings/{id}/approve triggers layer-2 auto-reject on overlapping booking
GET /api/bookings/check?code=LAB-2026-0042 returns status=ditolak and auto_rejected=true with smart rejection_reason
Frontend /cek-status?code=LAB-2026-0042 shows [data-testid=auto-rejected-badge-LAB-2026-0042] with text 'Auto-rejected' plus rejection_reason
Frontend /cek-status?code=LAB-2026-0043 (manual) shows NO auto-rejected badge but shows 'Manual test rejection' reason
